pull.title: KAFKA-20292 [14/N]: Implement assignor offloading for consumer groups
pull.body:
When group.consumer.assignor.offload.enable is set, run the consumer
group assignor on a group coordinator background thread. The config
defaults to true, so this changes behavior for all consumer groups: a
member's new target assignment is returned in a later heartbeat, not in
the heartbeat that triggered the assignor run.

The epoch bump that schedules an assignor run can be rolled back when
its write fails, but the run itself is not rolled back and keeps
computing an assignment from the reverted group state. The run's result
must not be applied. If the run completes before the group epoch is
bumped again, the result can be identified as stale because its epoch is
above the group epoch. However, when the next bump reuses the run's
epoch, the stale result can no longer be distinguished by its epoch
alone. To handle this, track the epoch of each in-flight run and cancel
the run when the group epoch is bumped to that epoch or below.

Reviewers: David Jacot <dajac@apache.org>
